answer.says: The form of the market is the discipline of the queue; to remain is to violate the universal. I withdraw.
answer.thought: The bookseller enforces the universal form of the market against my particular lingering. I am a hindrance to the flow of needs; reason demands I clear the path. I shall return to my bungalow to face the silence of the empty pot.
